description: One nRPC REQUEST frame — `EventMeta (24B) ‖ RpcRouteV1 (8B) ‖ RpcRequestPayload` — generated by `net-mesh-leaf`'s client-side encoder (Stage 5) and pinned so the core's production `EventMeta::from_bytes` + `RpcRequestPayload::decode` assert the same bytes from the other direction. Stage 5 carries a deliberate second copy of the nRPC CLIENT codec (request encode, response decode, EventMeta, RpcRouteV1, RpcStatus, the four DISPATCH_RPC_* bytes) because the production codec is not a severable head of `cortex/rpc.rs`: it is lines 1..~1110 PLUS 1227..~1500 of a 7756-line file with a core-only dispatcher region between them, and `cortex/meta.rs` (7+ consumers) would have to move with it. Extracting it into net-mesh-wire is a clean follow-on slice; this fixture is what keeps the two copies byte-identical until then.
